bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to taxation; extending the expiration of the food and beverage tax imposed by the city of Little Falls; amending Laws 1996, chapter 471, article 2, section 30, subdivision 5, as amended.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Laws 1996, chapter 471, article 2, section 30, subdivision 5, as amended by Laws 2009, chapter 88, article 4, section 17, subdivision 5, is amended to read:

Subd. 5.
Expiration of taxing authority.
The tax imposed under subdivision 1 expires [-30 years after it first becomes effective-][+ on July 1, 2056+].

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day after the governing body of the city of Little Falls and its chief clerical officer comply with Minnesota Statutes, section 645.021, subdivisions 2 and 3. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to taxation; extending the expiration of the food and beverage tax imposed by the city of Little Falls; amending Laws 1996, chapter 471, article 2, section 30, subdivision 5, as amended.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Laws 1996, chapter 471, article 2, section 30, subdivision 5, as amended by Laws 2009, chapter 88, article 4, section 17, subdivision 5, is amended to read:

Subd. 5.
Expiration of taxing authority.
The tax imposed under subdivision 1 expires on July 1, 2056.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day after the governing body of the city of Little Falls and its chief clerical officer comply with Minnesota Statutes, section 645.021, subdivisions 2 and 3.
